channel.title: ICHI — Critical vulnerability advisories
channel.description: One advisory per critical active threat ICHI tracks on the Internet Cyber Health Index (ichi.global), then only substantive, evidence-backed developments: exploitation newly established, a CISA KEV listing, a published fix or workaround, additional CVEs, corrections. Each item links to its own page on ichi.global with the supporting sources. A change in ICHI’s own assessment is not news and is not published here. Observation only; no score.

item.title: New advisory: CISA Adds 10 Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
item.description: ICHI assesses Mitel MiCollab (CVE-2026-133275, CVE-2026-133303, CVE-2026-133323, CVE-2026-133324) as a critical active threat. Exploitation is established by its sources. Listed in the CISA KEV catalog. First seen by ICHI 2026-11-25. Apply the vendor's fix or mitigations now — CISA remediation due in 3 days Sources: CISA Cybersecurity Advisories https://www.mitel.com/support/security-advisories/mitel-product-security-advisory-misa-2026-0012 · CISA KEV catalog entry for CVE-2026-133275 https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?field_cve=CVE-2026-133275 · CISA KEV catalog entry for CVE-2026-133303 https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?field_cve=CVE-2026-133303 · CISA KEV catalog entry for CVE-2026-133323 https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?field_cve=CVE-2026-133323 · CISA KEV catalog entry for CVE-2026-133324 https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?field_cve=CVE-2026-133324 Details and every source: https://ichi.global/alert?id=ichi-adv-202611-78d1f4fc328b353a
